data.name: Nadil
data.gender_notes: Nadil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-d-l', meaning 'to give' or 'to bestow'. In Islamic tradition, Nadil represents the idea of receiving blessings and gifts from Allah. The name Nadil carries the meaning “Gift, bounty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nadil usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, bounty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nadil is a name with deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is believed to be a name given by Allah to those who are deserving of His blessings and mercy.
data.etymology: Nadil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, bounty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadil total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
